notes.title: EA Update 5: Equilibrium
notes.content:
[h1][b]EA Update 5: Equilibrium[/b][/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/25abb8df36bed4c654936c625fcafc3449ee3dc7.png"][/img]
This update is packed with new content, big improvements, and one of the most requested features — Endless Mode![/p][h2]Endless Mode[/h2][p]One of the most requested features is finally here — Endless Mode! After defeating the worm, you can choose to stay in the level and face an endless horde of enemies. Even if you fall in the fight, your victory still counts.[/p][h2]9 New Characters[/h2][p]That’s right — we’ve added [b]nine new characters[/b] for you to unlock, experiment with, and build crazy runs around.[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/71986401b93470426bbe0f337feb9f18068fc5f2.png"][/img][/p][h3]5 New Enemy Skins[/h3][p]Enemy variety just got a big glow-up with [b]five brand-new enemy skins[/b].[/p][h3]Spores on Terrain[/h3][p]Spores can now grow directly on terrain. You can destroy them for a bit of extra EXP, so keep an eye out for them while exploring![/p][h3]Weapon Upgrades – Projectile Velocity[/h3][p]Your weapons can now upgrade their projectile velocity. Faster bullets = more damage potential and more satisfying gameplay.[/p][h3]The "Fun Meter"[/h3][p]We’ve added a mysterious new feature: the [b]Fun Meter[/b]. You’ll have to hop in and see what it does... 👀[/p][h3]Replayable Tutorial[/h3][p]You can now replay the tutorial whenever you want, perfect for onboarding friends or just refreshing your skills.[/p][h2]PATCH NOTES – VERSION 0.36.0[/h2][h3]🎨 VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS 🎨[/h3][list][*][p]Added outlines to item icons in the UI to indicate their rarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Cleaned up the visuals of several items.[/p][/*][*][p]Added buried objects inside the terrain for extra world detail.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the look of the Options Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visual effect for magnetized EXP.[/p][/*][*][p]Added vibration to Bomb Sack.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed controls: right-click is now used to hang; removed short left-click to hang.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved grappling line visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved Cross-Rifle visuals.[/p][/*][*][p]Added fungi and light rays to caves.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved character eye-tracking animations.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new visual for Health Eggs, now renamed to [b]Health Nodes[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]⚖️ BALANCE CHANGES ⚖️[/h3][list][*][p]Rebalanced enemy numbers and health.[/p][/*][*][p]Reduced the downsides of several weapon augments.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased chest prices in later levels.[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased lock-on range of the [b]Laser Pistol[/b] and [b]Bomb Thrower[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the chance for tag upgrades to appear (once you have at least two weapons with the same tag).[/p][/*][*][p]Completely reworked the passive abilities of all characters.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🤖 GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS 🤖[/h3][list][*][p]Added a Reset to Defaults button to the Options Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]The Options Menu can now be fully navigated using a controller.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the responsiveness of the grappling hook.[/p][/*][*][p]You can now see your current difficulty setting in the UI next to the level counter.[/p][/*][*][p]Re-added the swarm indicator to the compass.[/p][/*][*][p]Chests now open instantly, even if you are still grappling.[/p][/*][*][p]Continued optimization work — performance should be smoother across the board.[/p][/*][/list][h3]👾 BUG FIXES 👾[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a visual bug that made the grappling hook shoot to the right when returning to the player.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several UI bugs with item display in the Pause Menu.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug that disabled UI input after player death.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed incorrect Banish count display.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed misaligned visuals in the default explosion VFX.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed multiple item description typos.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where boss health was not properly synced with its segments.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare horizontal line artifact that sometimes appeared in the background.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Cryo-Blaster projectile visual bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the [b]Guardian Drone[/b] item:[/p][list][*][p]It now correctly reduces damage taken to [b]0[/b] (instead of 1).[/p][/*][*][p]It will no longer trigger damaged effects when you successfully dodge.[/p][/*][*][p]It will only activate after failing to dodge incoming damage.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Rotaser and Return-o-Matic did not receive extra projectiles from items until the next level.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: EA Update 4: ITEMS!!!
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/1be1b95737a2ea1ccaf636d31d14164d60dae104.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Attention, Slingbots![/h1][p]We’re excited to introduce a brand-new [b]Item System![/b] Items are a powerful new feature that allows you to craft crazy builds and experiment with endless possibilities. By combining different item effects, you can discover unique synergies, unlock new playstyles, and push your runs to the limit. Whether you want to go all-in on raw damage, build an unstoppable tank, or create wild combos that break the rules, Items open the door to completely new strategies.[/p][p][/p][p]Below, you can see all of the new items in their icon-y glory:[/p][p][/p][h3][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/af9048a483a3429ad1779f8d6c90a3909bef1685.png"][/img][/h3][p]You can get items by opening chests scattered all throughout the level, defeating mini-bosses, and by completing various side objectives.
So go on ahead, and show us all the new ways you found to break the game (and your enemies' morale)![/p][p][/p][h1]Balance Overhaul [/h1][p]We’ve completely reworked the game's balance! Pretty much every single stat has been touched, so going over them one by one would turn this post into a book. Here’s the short version: there are fewer enemies now, but they hit a lot harder, and upgrades feel a lot more impactful.[/p][p]Before, it could feel impossible to dodge damage because there were just too many enemies, and even if they hit you it didn’t matter much. Now, dodging is more important than ever—you can avoid enemies if you master the movement, but getting hit actually hurts.[/p][p]Since this is a huge balance change, we really want to hear what you think! Does the game feel easier or harder? Do you feel powerful when you manage to put together a crazy build? Jump into our Discord and let us know—we’re reading all your feedback!
[/p][h1][b]Background Walls (and glowing plants!)[/b][/h1][p]We added grabbable walls to every level for extra visual variety, and because we wanted to add glow to stuff—and it just looks way better with a wall behind it.
[/p][h1][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/effe1e45e1a00638b7a130ba78f0b2c6846bd28d.png"][/img][/h1][h1][b]PATCH NOTES – VERSION 0.35.0[/b][/h1][h3]🎨 [b]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS[/b] 🎨[/h3][list][*][p]Added grabbable walls to every level in the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Added glow effects to many environments—especially noticeable in darker areas.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the visual effects of the Laser Pistol, Shotgun, Cross-Rifle, and Bubble Gun.[/p][/*][*][p]Went over all levels and adjusted object placements to improve visual consistency.[/p][/*][/list][h3]🤖 [b]GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS[/b] 🤖[/h3][list][*][p]Further optimizations have been made, so you should see a nice boost in performance and a few extra frames this update.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][h3][/h3]

notes.title: EA Update 3: A Fresh Coat of Paint (Part 1)
notes.content:
[h1]Hey There, Slingbots![/h1][p]We have a smaller patch for you today, but that's because we cooked something for you that simply couldn't wait in our oven any longer![/p][p][/p][h3][b]Introducing: Weapon Arms![/b][/h3][p]To make your bug-squashing experience ever more awesome, most* of your weapons will now hover around you, to personally deliver robot-justice to your buzzing foes![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/f958ceaa468ed312e2289a45d073ed0af098ae4a.gif"][/img][/p][p][i]*With the exception of "Orbital" weapons (Rotaser, Orbital Saws) and "Aura" weapons (Static Field, Fire Trail), which simply begged to remain on the player itself ;)[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Improved Visual Clarity[/b][/h3][p]We also increased the size of the player, the enemies, and their projectiles, in order to improve the visual clarity of the game and reduce some of the disorienting chaos we heard in many of your feedbacks :)[/p][h3]
[b]Enhanced Combat Feedback[/b][/h3][p]In addition to the weapon arms, we also improved the VFX and SFX of hitting and killing enemies, to make every bug squashed ever more punchy and satisfying![/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p]As you may have noticed, this is [b]Part 1[/b] of our visual update! [/p][p][b]Part 2[/b] will come out shortly after, and include stunning changes to our environment! Stay tuned![/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h1][b]PATCH NOTES – VERSION 0.33.1 (24-07-25)[/b][/h1][h3]🎨 [b]VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS[/b] 🎨[/h3][list][*][p]Added floating weapons to some weapons with funky spring-like movement for extra style.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased [b]player size[/b] to make spotting your Slingbot easier when the screen is swarming with enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased [b]enemy sizes[/b] for better visibility during intense battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]hit and death effects[/b] for enemies to make combat feel more impactful.[/p][/*][*][p]Made [b]enemy projectiles bigger[/b] so they’re easier to notice and dodge.[/p][/*][*][p]Added [b]particle effects[/b] when projectiles are destroyed for extra visual feedback.[/p][/*][*][p]Upgraded visuals for [b]Laser Pistol, Shotgun, and Cross Rifle[/b] projectiles.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved [b]in-game UI[/b] to block less of the gameplay screen.[/p][/*][*][p]Made the [b]grappling hook line thicker[/b] for better clarity.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]⚖️ [b]BALANCE CHANGES[/b] ⚖️[/h3][list][*][p][b]Bomb Dropper[/b] now targets the closest enemy for better effectiveness.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Bomb Sack[/b] now deals more damage and explodes much faster.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased the speed of [b]fast enemies[/b] but slightly reduced their health for better balance.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]🤖 [b]GENERAL IMPROVEMENTS[/b] 🤖[/h3][list][*][p]Improved [b]grappling hook mechanics[/b] to feel more consistent, added more accurate hit prediction, and introduced [b]aim assist[/b] for easier usage.[/p][/*][*][p]Increased [b]grappling hook pull force[/b] for snappier movement.[/p][/*][*][p]Enhanced the [b]sound effect[/b] when picking up experience orbs for better feedback.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]👾 [b]BUG FIXES[/b] 👾[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where [b]music would not play[/b] when starting a new run after dying.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: EA Update 02: Tremors in the Earth
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/d1aa198303afdde572216d690af48a1ec9f313dc.png"][/img][/p][h1]Attention, Slingbots! [/h1][p][/p][p]We’ve got a big one for you - literally. [/p][p]In this update, your runs now bring you face to face with an earth-shattering new final boss: [b]The Great, Bot-Eating Worm[/b]. It’s massive. It’s angry. And it’s here to make sure you earn your victory.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/bd5d9a709ad83a078d84df16f5dba3097de656ce.gif"][/img][/p][p]This isn’t just another bullet sponge. To take it down, you’ll need to hunt it segment by segment, breaking it apart by targeting its exposed weak points and surviving long enough to rip it apart from the inside.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/48b54417e8125853d1b74a96d5ae8db2c025b423.gif"][/img][/p][p]But it won’t go down without a fight. notes.title: EA Update 01: Living World
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/5b4a63843f9264a248fd2906aeaf40c625a2395f.png[/img]
[h1]Attention, Slingbots![/h1]

Welcome to the first major update for Slingbot Survivors, "Living World"!

We've been hard at work to deliver more fun experiences to our awesome community, and our first update aims to do just that: More things to do, activities to complete, hazards to avoid, and of course, rewards to be gained!

You can check out the new features highlighted below, or simply scroll to the bottom for the full patch notes.

[h2][b]4 new environmental objects[/b][/h2]
First, we aim to make our environment more rich and varied, and enhance your traversal experience, using fun new interactable objects scattered throughout each level! Including new challenges, rewards, powerups and hazards, exploring each level will never feel the same!

[h3][b]🏁Ring Race🏁[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/32dd647cf98c1b0fb760fc524f0b87420c076122.gif[/img]
Put your skills to the test with our new races! During a race, you'll need to pass through each ring and reach the end in time, where you'll be rewarded based on how quick you completed it!

[h3][b]🕸Infested Hive🕸[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/e42ed57b116d2063edd426b9cbd7a9e1589469ba.gif[/img]
New hives will discovered across the planet, where our enemies gather their forces and multiply before their next assault. Find them, smash them into pieces, and reap precious rewards!

[i]Just be warned, because it will definitely draw their attention...[/i]

[h3][b]🍄Bounce-Shrooms🍄[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/85f7c233a127a93e66b17726efc157e2619805b4.gif[/img]
These juicy plants possess powerful bouncy properties, and by extracting their energized juices, you can gain a powerful, bouncy shield to use against your enemies!

[h3][b]💣Bomb-Sacs💣[/b][/h3]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/f3622decebbef3dfeb2f63b900d436fdfb27a076.gif[/img]
Be careful around these things! Scattered across the level, these volatile plants react to the slightest touch, triggering a powerful chain explosions! However, the resourceful Sling-Bot could surely use them to their advantage...

[h2][b]🍃The world comes to life🍃[/b][/h2][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45503946/0e9492476925dd1ece6cc1b18b07fe96eccdbda6.gif[/img]
Also, after much hard work and black magic from our resident lead developer, we've unlocked the technology to [b]animate the environment[/b]! Each vine, coral and egg-sac will now react, bend and bounce when you pull it!

Together with various new balance improvements and a slew of QoL features, we hope this will be a patch fit for our awesome community!

[h2][b]PATCH NOTES - VERSION 0.32.0 (29-05-25):[/b][/h2]
[h3]🆕NEW CONTENT🆕[/h3]
[list]
[*] The Ring Race, Infested Hive, Bounce-Shroom and Bomb-Sacs have been added to the game.
[*] The flora has been bestowed with new animated properties (the plants now go [i]bounce[/i]).
[*] The Lighting Gun has undergone a complete overhaul, and became a "Rail Gun" that targets the highest health enemy in range (it also got some spicy new augments).
[/list]

[b][h3]🤖GAMEPLAY IMPROVEMENTS🤖[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] The community's cries have finally been answered, and you can now upgrade your Grappling Range and Pull Force! (which is effectively your movement speed).
[*] The "V0ltron" character now starts with the Static Field.
[*] Significantly improved the UI navigation experience using a controller.
[*] Balanced audio levels throughout the game.
[*] Reduced the HP of the purple eggs in the tutorial, which were higher than normal eggs (creating an annoying experience for new players). However, the first "tutorial egg" will now always die in EXACTLY 2 hits, to steamline the tutorial experience.
[*] Added a 3rd egg to the tutorial level, on the ceiling
[/list]

[b][h3]🎨VISUAL IMPROVEMENTS🎨[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] The progress fill of the Biofuel drone is now much more clear and accurate.
[*] Slightly reduced the VFX size of the various explosions to better match their actual hitbox.
[*] The Firefly's projectile got a major makeover, and are now as slimy and dangerous as ever.
[/list]

[b][h3]⚖️BALANCE CHANGES⚖️[/h3]
[/b][list]
[b]General:[/b]
[*] Increased shop prices by 10% (to balance the increased currency gained from the Ring Race and Infested Hive)

[b]Player:[/b]
[*] Reduced EXP required to level up after level 15 by around 10%.

[b]Quests:[/b]
[*] Increased the Biofuel’s required amount scaling per level
[*] Increased the required amount of power gems to collect from 6 to 8

[b]Environment:[/b]
[*] The eggs no longer also drop percentage-based EXP (in addition to the flat EXP they drop)

[b]Enemies:[/b]
[*] Slightly reduced enemy amounts and increased movement speed at higher difficulties.
[*] Further reduced enemy spawn amounts in the first level by about 15%-20%, to make the difficulty curve more forgiving and give players time to breathe.
[*] Lowered the maximum amount of active enemies from 400 to 300
[*] Reduced the rate at which the enemies' health & spawn numbers increase during the boss fight (when they "Enrage"), but also slightly increased the rate at which their movement speed increases.
[*] Increased the distance between enemies and their hitbox size (so it's easier to hit them)
[*] Increased the Firefly's (ranged enemy) projectile size by 20%, damage from 7 to 10, and the Firefly's lock-on range
[*] Increased Fireflies' base HP from 170 to 200, but reduced their base contact damage from 7 to 5
[*] Increased the fast enemies' base HP from 100 to 120, damage from 7 to 8, and dropped EXP from 100 to 200.
[*] Made fast enemies fly through all other enemies (except other fast enemies), as they used to do. No escaping from them!
[*] Slightly increased the damaging hitbox of the tier 1 normal enemies, tier 2 normal enemies, fast enemies and tanks.
[*] Tier 1 Normal enemies now drop 150 EXP at a 50% rate, instead of 100 EXP at a 75% rate (so same rate overall, just less EXP particles).
[*] Tier 2 Normal enemies now drop 200 EXP at a 50% rate, so 30% more than the tier 1 ones (they used to drop the same amount as them)
[*] Reduced magnet drop rates on normal enemies from 1/2000 to 1/4000, but increased them on Tanks from 1/750 to 1/500.

[u][b]WEAPONS:[/b][/u]
[b]Bubble Gun:[/b]
[*] Increased projectile velocity by 33%.

[b]Rotaser:[/b]
[*] Increased duration from 3 to 4 seconds, but increased cooldown from 8 to 10 seconds. Overall this is a buff to the weapon's lifetime, intended to make it slightly more reliable at earlier levels.
[*] Removed the "B.F.G" augment's +30% damage bonus and +50% rotation speed bonus. That gun was just too f**king big.

[b]Orbital Saws:
[/b][*] Reduced its base status potency when augmented with Cold by 35%.
[*] Reduced the rotation speed granted by the "Accelerated Engines" augment from +100% to +75%.
[*] Increased the damage penalty of the "Pocket Saw-Mension" augment (that grants another layer of saws) from -50% to -65% (Sorry for all the saw enthusiasts in the crowd, I had to do it do 'em).

[b]Shotgun:
[/b][*] Lowered the base damage from 70 to 60 (because it overperfomed a little too much, especially in the early game, allowing you to kill bosses far too quickly)
Static Field:
[*] Increased base damage from 10 to 12, and base status potency from 6 to 10 (to help it out in the early game and improve its viability as a primary weapon)
[/list]

[b][h3]👾BUGFIXES & OPTIMIZATION👾[/h3]
[/b][list]
[*] Greatly improved the performance of the game (you can now achieve a smooth framerate on the Steam Deck).
[*] Fixed ranged enemies firing at a faster rate than intended.
[*] Fixed floating main menu items no longer animating when re-entering the main menu.
[*] Fixed bug that caused the compass pointer to point to the wrong direction at first.
[*] Fixed bug that prevented the spawning of a single enemy
[*] Fix Rotaser beam count updating during fire.
[*] Generally improved the stability of the game.
[/list]


That's all for now, but don't worry: In our next major update (coming in a month or so) we're gonna answer many of your other requests for the game, so keep on the lookout! We're planning pretty spicy things ahead...

(And please join our Discord! We have memes!)

notes.title: Patch 0.31.3
notes.content:
IMPROVEMENTS:
[list]
[*] We have finally unlocked the technology to display the weapon tags in the weapon's stat block (in the stat panel). Blessed be their names.
[*] Added a meta currency ("Metacium") multiplier on higher difficulty levels.
[*] The player is now invincible (title card) during the boss' death sequence, and for a short while (0.5s) after.
[*] The boss' death animation delay has been slightly shortened to better match the pacing of the sequence.
[*] Shortened the time it takes for the EXP & Health pickups dropped by the boss to reach the player, in order to increase the likelihood the heal will save them from imminent death.
[*] Re-arranged the sorting order of most weapon visuals in order to create a clearer visual hierarchy (for example, the fire trail is now rendered behind all other projectiles).
[*] The weapon frames are now displayed in the shop (and in the black void of level ups that appears before the shop).
[*] Added diminishing return to screen shake so you don't get sick while inside a swarm of bugs.
[/list]
BALANCE CHANGES:
[list]
[*] Increased bomb thrower base explosion radius (from 6 to 7) and proximity trigger radius (from 4 to 5).
[*] Buffed the laser pistol's "Velocity Overdrive" augment and improved the wording of its description.
[*] The bubble gun's "Sentient Plasma" augment (aka homing bubbles) now also grants +30% Projectile Speed, enabling the interaction with the "Static Plasma" augment (which causes the bubbles to stop moving). Taking both augments will now lead to a total of x0.3 projectile speed.
[*] Increased the homing bubbles' rotation speed.
[*] Increased the projectile speed bonus of the bubble gun's "Experimental Plasma Charger" augment from 50% to 75%.
[/list]
BUGFIXES:
[list]
[*] Fixed bug which set the Static Field's scale to 0 at the start of a new level (causing it to "disappear").
[*] Hopefully fixed a rare bug that disabled the grappling input after defeating the boss.
[*] Fixed tutorial pop-ups appearing over the pause menu.
[*] Fixed several bugs with the Capitalist Programming gadget.
[*] Fixed music not starting when you start a new run after winning.
[*] Fixed sound settings not saving your previous preferences.
[*] Fixed enemies having the cold effect on them when they spawn.
[/list]

notes.content:

[*] 4 New Weapons
[*] 12 New Gadgets
[*] 2 New Difficulty Levels

Get ready to take on new challenges and unlock powerful rewards!

notes.title: Hotfix 0.29.5
notes.content:
[h1] What's coming next?[/h1]
Next week, we have a big update coming up with the new milestone system that lets you unlock new characters, weapons, gadgets, and difficulties.

[list]
[*] During gameplay, your mouse now stays locked inside the game window — no more wandering to another monitor (unless you pause the game).
[*] The boss now explodes into a glorious pile of body parts.
[*] Status effect damage numbers will now appear in different colors.
[/list]

[h1]Bug Fixes[/h1]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue where refreshing the shop stopped the background music.
[*] Fixed an issue that set the volume to max when entering the settings menu (we apologize for any hearing damage dealt).
[*] Fixed an issue where the Bubble gun projectiles' visuals disappeared too early.
[*] Fixed many UI elements that didn’t render correctly at certain resolutions.
[/list]
